payload.purpose_context: A 24-hour CI census showed PR pipelines wait a median 33 minutes when the architectural battery runs, the battery uses half its runner, about 12-15% of runner-minutes are duplicate runs, and the nightly does not actually run the full architectural battery. This mission makes contributors get faster, earlier and honest CI signal without weakening any gate (issue #5510).
payload.purpose_tldr: Cut PR CI wallclock and duplicate runner-minutes while making the architectural safety net honest.

payload.question: Router tests(corpus) feeds the required router gate; Packs is not required. Who owns the corpus suite?

payload.final_answer: Packs owns, accept non-blocking (corpus failures become advisory; Packs triggers must cover every path the Router corpus job triggered on)

payload.question: How far should the ready_for_review skip-if-green guard go (Aggregate fail-closed; required check passing on prior-run evidence)?

payload.final_answer: Full, with ADR amendment: Router, Modules and Packs via one scripts/ci helper; CI Aggregate reuses the matched run's coverage artifacts; amend ADR 2026-09-23-1

options: Widen the ci group and registry row

payload.final_answer: Keep the 35 blocking: give them a blocking-lane home and deselect them from the Packs corpus run

payload.final_answer: Yes: unit tests against recorded API fixtures now; live verification on first post-merge ready-for-review PR recorded as follow-up
